title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
summary: Tomas Mikolov, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, and Jeffrey Dean submitted 'Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space' on January 16, 2013. The paper proposes two model architectures for efficiently computing continuous vector representations of words from very large data sets.
significance: A documented natural-language-processing research milestone introducing two efficient architectures for learning continuous word representations at large scale.
